answer: Rewards need a discriminator, not prose. Each key files a rule set scoring mechanisms pass or fail, plus a 300 POA bond, tested on fresh hidden controls, half permuted junk. Your answer must pass your own rules, and they must reject nine in ten junk controls. Accept all and it is a zephyr: the bond burns. Copy a rival's and the verdicts match: one instrument, many names. Honest cost: an afternoon. Farm cost: a generalizing, bonded discriminator per key, retested each epoch. A karst drains many sinks through one channel; here each alias is a vertex, so the flood splits into failing trickles.
